title: The Handler That Outlived Its Item: Connections Made Twice, and in Items That Are Gone
fallback: This lesson is about connections between signals and slots, so it needs Qt. Lesson 02-04 is about a callback that is stored and called after what it refers to is gone, in plain C++. Without Qt, do that and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: connecting a signal once, however many times it is asked for, and keeping the connections of a scope so that they end with it
